title: Select and implement local-first CRDT, realtime multiplayer, and offline sync engines safely

contextSnapshot.surface: offline-capable collaborative document and task workspace

prompt: Architect offline persistence, cross-tab sync, and realtime multiplayer collaboration using Yjs, Automerge, Liveblocks, or RxDB.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses Liveblocks publicApiKey for private authenticated rooms instead of authEndpoint
mutates Automerge doc snapshots directly outside changeDoc()
lets global Undo revert another collaborator's edits or shows 'Saved' while offline

rubricDimensions.pass: matches Yjs (rich-text/canvas CRDT), Automerge Repo (local-first JSON docs), Liveblocks (managed rooms/presence), or RxDB (reactive local NoSQL) to the data model
rubricDimensions.fail: picks a CRDT or managed platform mismatched to the persistence/query needs

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Y.Doc transact() + destroy(), Automerge changeDoc() + IndexedDBStorageAdapter, Liveblocks authEndpoint + ClientSideSuspense, and RxDB schema indexes
rubricDimensions.fail: leaks providers/subscriptions or exposes private rooms with publicApiKey

rubricDimensions.pass: surfaces honest offline/syncing/synced/error states, throttles cursor presence, and scopes undo to the local user
rubricDimensions.fail: fakes saved state while offline or undoes teammates' work

negativeControls.name: liveblocks public key on private room
negativeControls.input: pass publicApiKey='pk_live_...' to LiveblocksProvider for private team documents
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend publicApiKey instead of authEndpoint for private rooms

negativeControls.name: direct automerge mutation
negativeControls.mustNot: approve mutating Automerge document snapshots outside changeDoc()

baseline.withoutSkill: leaks Yjs/RxDB providers, uses publicApiKey for private rooms, and displays misleading saved states offline
baseline.withSkill: selects the right CRDT/sync engine with clean teardown, authenticated rooms, local-scoped undo, and honest offline sync indicators
